notes: ACCESS: Tier (a) direct HTTP (curl_cffi, chrome120 impersonation) worked for robots.txt and the XML sitemap (Akamai does not challenge these static assets) but every HTML page (home, category) returned an Akamai Bot Manager interstitial JS-challenge shell (~2KB, meta-refresh + sensor script) - not usable for parsing, so tier (a) was insufficient for actual page content. Tier (b) Playwright headless=True got a hard 'Access Denied' (Akamai fingerprints headless Chromium). Escalated within tier (b) to headless=False (headed) Chromium with --disable-blink-features=AutomationControlled, which passed the Akamai challenge cleanly and loaded the real Angular-SSR site; reused via storage_state across subsequent page loads. Tier (c) Claude-in-Chrome was not needed. robots.txt (fetched via tier a) has no anthropic-ai/ClaudeBot/Claude-Web/Claude-User/Claude-SearchBot entries and no blanket 'User-agent: * / Disallow: /', so no tier is blocked by policy. TREE: built the union of (1) the AE-locale category XML sitemap (https://www.zarahome.com/8/info/sitemaps/sitemap-home-categories-zh-ae-0.xml.gz, 299 English-locale URLs after de-duplicating the /ar/ Arabic mirror) and (2) each visited category page's own on-page breadcrumb + tab-strip sub-navigation, which is the site's true hierarchy signal (URL slugs are not reliable - e.g. 'bathroom-toiletry-wash-bags' is filed under Clothing and Footwear > Wash Bags in the real breadcrumb, not Bathroom). Several sitemap URLs suffixed '-all-' or whose breadcrumb's last element read 'SEE ALL' are the group's own View-All aggregator tab and were excluded per the Parent Category URL Rule whenever true sibling subcategory pages exist (bedroom-basic-sheets-n1799, dining-table-linen-tablecloths-n1034, home-decor-rugs-living-room-n992, kids-bedding-n1097). Three sitemap URLs were dead (redirect to /ae/error.html 'Page unavailable'): bedroom-fillings-n954, laundry-all-n4133, livingroom-rugs-all-n4121 - skipped. winter-duvet-n4965 loaded normally with a confirmed Bedding>Quilts>Duvets breadcrumb but rendered 0 product cards and duplicates the already-captured Duvets leaf, so it was omitted rather than recorded as a fabricated/duplicate row. QTY: Zara Home shows no explicit 'N products' counter; the AE store uses lazy-load-on-scroll inside an Angular Material sidenav container (not the window), so qty = the count of article.product-item cards after programmatically scrolling that inner container to bottom repeatedly until the count was stable across 3+ consecutive checks (site's own exact rendered count, not an estimate). EXCLUDED and why: home-decor-baskets-n997 and home-decor-jewellery-boxes-n971 (breadcrumbed under HOME DECOR, not a Storage/Organization group - decorative-basket/jewellery-box boundary per storage.md Sec5/Sec24, belongs to Decorative Home Accessories, out of this task's scope); bathroom-toiletry-wash-bags-n4748 (breadcrumb: Clothing and Footwear > Wash Bags and Bags - personal carrying bag, not home textile/storage); picnic-collection-n1812 (mixed general-merchandise themed Collection - plates/cutlery/blankets/baskets combined under one qty, not a clean single-type category); bathroom-bins-n3827 ('Functional bathroom bins' = waste/trash bins, not storage/organization containers); kids-hangers-n1131 (hangers - not in storage.md's covered list, filed under Clothing and Shoes not a Storage group); laundry-care-n1399 (mixed laundry-equipment listing - ironing boards, detergent jars/dispensers, dryer balls, clothes pegs - predominantly non-storage items per storage.md Sec11/Sec30, no dedicated storage-only sub-listing); laundry-cleaning-n2485 (kitchen cleaning accessories, not storage); dressing-room-n2463 / dressing-room-all-n5640 (its own 'Storage' tab is a same-URL celement filter pointing back to bathroom-baskets-all-n4142, already captured; the page itself is a Hangers+Furniture+Storage aggregate, not a distinct category); furniture-storage-n4111 (filed under the site's Furniture nav group alongside armchairs/cabinets/shelvings - Furniture.xlsx's domain, out of scope here, not re-verified since that workbook is already validated/complete). LOW-confidence rows (review queue): Napkins (paper+fabric mixed on one listing) and Bathrobes and Slippers (bathrobes+footwear mixed on one listing) - both flagged because the site's own listing page mixes a textile product type with a non-textile one and provides no way to isolate an exact textile-only count.
